# CuttingKnots

> CuttingKnots is an Italian technology partner for companies. It offers two things with equal weight: (1) IT consulting, systems integration and custom software, starting from a concrete business problem; (2) its own software products, each at a clearly stated stage of development. The site is bilingual (Italian at /, English at /en). Contact: info@cuttingknots.com (reply within two working days). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cutting-knots LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cutting-knots

Key facts, stated as on the site:
- Problems addressed: manual and repetitive work (automation, also with AI: reading documents, extracting and checking data); systems that don't talk (integration between ERP, PLM and business systems such as SAP and Teamcenter); processes no tool covers (custom web applications and Mendix low-code); data that is hard to query (plain-language questions to databases, conversion to common standards such as OMOP); choosing technologies and vendors.
- How work starts: you write a few lines; CuttingKnots replies within two working days and, if the problem is one it can solve, suggests a first conversation; then goals and the current process are analysed and a path is proposed (build, integrate or adopt an existing solution).
- Products and real status (none is in general use yet):
  - 3D STEP Simplifier — pilot. Simplifies 3D STEP models while keeping shape and dimensions. One test on a KUKA robot model: 55.98 MB to 3.21 MB (−94.3%) in 86.1 s. Single test, not an average.
  - Professional Network Monitor — pilot. Organises companies, contacts and collaborations and shows how professional relationships evolve.
  - VIGIL — prototype. Industrial computer vision that turns production-line video into cycles, stops and OEE. Demo interface with simulated data and preliminary tests; validation on real plants still to come.
  - AIDA — in development. Personal assistant that turns email, notes and to-dos into a plan for the day; next step is connecting Outlook and Gmail calendars.
- Experience: six projects delivered by people on the team in previous roles (not CuttingKnots clients or commissions), in automotive, healthcare, events and research. Team background also includes banking and finance projects.
